python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3, json
src='/app/main.db'
dst='/app/recovered.json'
con=sqlite3.connect('file:'+src+'?mode=ro&immutable=1', uri=True)
rows=con.execute('SELECT id, name, value FROM inventory ORDER BY id').fetchall()
con.close()
records=[{'id': int(i), 'name': str(n), 'value': int(v)} for i,n,v in rows]
with open(dst,'w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(records, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print('wrote',len(records),'records to',dst)
print(open(dst,encoding='utf-8').read())
PY
